definitions.explanation: Describes a temperament that naturally looks on the bright side and does not worry excessively. Implies an innate personality trait rather than a deliberate attitude.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{楽天的|らくてんてき}な⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧だ。
⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧{楽天的|らくてんてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{考|かんが}えた→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧⟦ほうがいい→ほうがいい：10078_hougaii⟧。
examples.english: You should think about it a bit more optimistically.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あって→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{楽天的|らくてんてき}で、⟦{周|まわ}り→周り：01732_mawari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{明|あか}るく→明るい：00616_akarui⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: No matter what happens, she is optimistic and brightens the people around her.

notes:
Describes a temperament that naturally looks on the bright side and doesn't worry excessively. Derived from {楽天|らくてん} (optimism, literally "enjoying heaven") + ⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧ (adjectival suffix).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {楽天的|らくてんてき}な⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧: optimistic personality
- {楽天的|らくてんてき}な⟦{考|かんが}え{方|かた}→考え方：10169_kangaekata⟧: optimistic way of thinking
- {楽天的|らくてんてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{考|かんが}える→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧: to think optimistically
- {楽天的|らくてんてき}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: an optimistic person

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{前向|まえむ}き→前向き：10073_maemuki⟧: forward-looking, positive — focuses on proactive attitude rather than temperament
- {能天気|のうてんき}: carefree to the point of being oblivious — more negative, implying someone is thoughtlessly unconcerned
- ⟦{悲観的|ひかんてき}→悲観的：06091_hikanteki⟧: pessimistic — the direct opposite
